mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{todayStart} AND create_time < #{tomorrowStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{monthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS month FROM ${tableName} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT COALESCE(result, flow_status, 'UNKNOWN') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ai_business_flow_instance_link WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND object_code = #{objectCode} GROUP BY COALESCE(result, flow_status, 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY value DESC
